name: 90077 · Los Angeles, CA
findings: ZIP 90077 (Los Angeles) has 107 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90077 (Los Angeles) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 90077 (Los Angeles) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 21% of all organizations here have no identified type.
